git_check_observations_identity_check.name: git_check_observations_identity_check
git_check_observations_identity_check.value: "git_check_observations"."repository_id" between 1 and 9007199254740991 and "git_check_observations"."attempt_id" between 1 and 9007199254740991 and "git_check_observations"."head_sha" ~ '^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$'

git_check_observations_status_check.name: git_check_observations_status_check
git_check_observations_status_check.value:
("git_check_observations"."provider" = 'github' and "git_check_observations"."status" in ('requested', 'queued', 'in_progress', 'pending', 'waiting', 'completed') and "git_check_observations"."job_total" is null and "git_check_observations"."job_failed" is null and (("git_check_observations"."status" = 'completed') = ("git_check_observations"."conclusion" is not null))) or
          ("git_check_observations"."provider" = 'gitlab' and "git_check_observations"."status" in ('created', 'waiting_for_resource', 'preparing', 'pending', 'running', 'success', 'failed', 'canceled', 'skipped') and "git_check_observations"."conclusion" is null)

git_check_observations_times_check.name: git_check_observations_times_check
git_check_observations_times_check.value: "git_check_observations"."observed_at_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and ("git_check_observations"."completed_at_ms" is null or "git_check_observations"."completed_at_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991) and ("git_check_observations"."job_total" is null or "git_check_observations"."job_total" between 0 and 9007199254740991) and ("git_check_observations"."job_failed" is null or "git_check_observations"."job_failed" between 0 and "git_check_observations"."job_total")

git_repository_mappings_provider_check.name: git_repository_mappings_provider_check
git_repository_mappings_provider_check.value: ("git_repository_mappings"."provider" = 'github' and "git_repository_mappings"."installation_id" is not null and "git_repository_mappings"."installation_id" > 0) or ("git_repository_mappings"."provider" = 'gitlab' and "git_repository_mappings"."installation_id" is null)

git_dispatch_claims_result_check.name: git_dispatch_claims_result_check
git_dispatch_claims_result_check.value: ("git_dispatch_claims"."status" = 'completed' and "git_dispatch_claims"."disposition" is not null and "git_dispatch_claims"."disposition" in ('applied','no_op') and "git_dispatch_claims"."task_id" is not null and "git_dispatch_claims"."list_id" is not null and "git_dispatch_claims"."space_id" is not null) or ("git_dispatch_claims"."status" in ('pending','closed') and "git_dispatch_claims"."disposition" is null and "git_dispatch_claims"."task_id" is null and "git_dispatch_claims"."list_id" is null and "git_dispatch_claims"."space_id" is null)

git_links_head_check.name: git_links_head_check
git_links_head_check.value:
("git_links"."head_sha" is null and "git_links"."head_first_observed_at_ms" is null and "git_links"."head_last_observed_at_ms" is null) or
          ("git_links"."head_sha" is not null and "git_links"."head_first_observed_at_ms" is not null and "git_links"."head_last_observed_at_ms" is not null and "git_links"."head_sha" ~ '^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$' and "git_links"."head_first_observed_at_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "git_links"."head_last_observed_at_ms" between "git_links"."head_first_observed_at_ms" and 9007199254740991)

git_links_aggregate_check.name: git_links_aggregate_check
git_links_aggregate_check.value: "git_links"."checks" is null or ("git_links"."head_sha" is not null and jsonb_typeof("git_links"."checks") = 'object')

git_links_line_counts_check.name: git_links_line_counts_check
git_links_line_counts_check.value: ("git_links"."additions" is null or "git_links"."additions" between 0 and 9007199254740991) and ("git_links"."deletions" is null or "git_links"."deletions" between 0 and 9007199254740991)

git_links_members_check.name: git_links_members_check
git_links_members_check.value: jsonb_typeof("git_links"."member_observed_at_ms") = 'object' and ("git_links"."repository" is null or jsonb_typeof("git_links"."repository") = 'object') and ("git_links"."author" is null or jsonb_typeof("git_links"."author") = 'object')

git_merge_intents_result_check.name: git_merge_intents_result_check
git_merge_intents_result_check.value:
("git_merge_intents"."status" = 'pending' and "git_merge_intents"."disposition" is null and "git_merge_intents"."reason" is null and "git_merge_intents"."target_status" = 'done') or
          ("git_merge_intents"."status" = 'handled' and ("git_merge_intents"."disposition" is null) <> ("git_merge_intents"."reason" is null) and ("git_merge_intents"."disposition" is null or "git_merge_intents"."disposition" in ('applied', 'no_op')))

outbox_events_lease_check.name: outbox_events_lease_check
outbox_events_lease_check.value:
("outbox_events"."status" = 'leased' and "outbox_events"."lease_token" is not null and "outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
        or ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'leased' and "outbox_events"."lease_token" is null and "outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" is null)
